summary: Coordinates on the map and on screen, waypoints with a direction arrow, map notes, and pins for every area you have visited.
description: Forever Atlas shows your coordinates on the world map and in a small movable read-out on screen. Set a waypoint with /way 45.2 61.8 and follow the arrow, which shows the distance in yards. Alt-click the world map to add your own notes. The addon also records each area you walk into and shows it as a pin on the map. Type /fatlas for commands.
